sealedIndex.name: Catchem Sealed Index
sealedIndex.baseline: each product vs its first clean-history price (2026-08-18 cut)
sealedIndex.simple: One number for all 174 sealed products. 100 was the starting line; 100 means the whole shelf is worth more than when we started. Each product competes only against itself — one product, one vote.
